Package frc.robot.subsystems.drivetrain

Class Drivetrain

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.drivetrain.Drivetrain
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public class Drivetrain extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
The swerve drivetrain subsystem.

This subsystem handles all robot movement through four independent swerve modules. It manages:

  • Module velocity and angle control
  • Gyroscope-based rotation tracking
  • Pose estimation using swerve kinematics and vision measurements
  • Multiple drive control modes (field-relative, robot-relative, alliance-relative)
  • Dashboard visualization via the Field2d widget and Elastic dashboard

The drivetrain uses a dependency injection pattern to support both real hardware (NavX gyro, Spark motor controllers) and replay/simulation alternatives.

  • Constructor Details

    • Drivetrain

      public Drivetrain(Function<SwerveConstants.ModuleId,ModuleIO> moduleFactory, GyroIO gyro, QuestIO quest)
      Constructs a new Drivetrain subsystem. Creates all four swerve modules, initializes the pose estimator, and sets up the gyroscope. The actual hardware implementations are provided via dependency injection.
      Parameters:
      moduleFactory - A factory function that creates swerve modules based on their configuration
      gyro - The gyroscope implementation (NavX or GyroReplay)
      quest - The Quest IO implementation (Meta3S or QuestReplay)

    • addVisionMeasurement

      public void addVisionMeasurement(VisionConstants.VisionMeasurement measurement)
      Incorporates a vision measurement into the pose estimate. Allows the pose estimator to correct odometry drift using camera-based pose detection. The measurement includes position, rotation, timestamp, and measurement covariance.
      Parameters:
      measurement - The vision measurement to incorporate

    • calibrate

      private void calibrate()
      Calibrate the initial pose of the robot Photon/AprilTag measurements are recorded and collected while the robot is disabled. Once enabled, we average the latest few measurements and set our starting pose to that.

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Periodic update method called every 20ms.

      Updates all drivetrain components and logs data for analysis:

      • Reads gyroscope heading
      • Updates all swerve modules
      • Updates pose estimator
      • Logs data to AdvantageKit
      • Updates dashboard displays
